Lemme give you some tips for night 5 about the thing

1. When she (the puppet) comes through the portal, don't camp her. Wait and look at her eyes and wait for her to come out of the portal and finish her animation, if they are purple, flash her with your flashlight, but if they are red, you're dead.  You can't do anything to stop her. She will just sprint at you, and she is faster than you.
2. The dead children, the things around the map dont walk into them, they will hold you and it will attract the puppet to your location.
3. Constantly move around; if you stay in one spot or don't move about, her eyes will turn red, and the reason for this is your sanity. The game doesn't have a bar to indicate your sanity's levels, but if you camp in one spot, her eyes will turn red, and you cannot do anything about that.
4. After flipping the breaker, I think 4+ times the shadow thing known as Nightmare Freadbare will spawn. He will roam about, and he will kill you if you touch him but I don't know for sure so be cautious about him.

And this should conclude night 5 and some about the things gamode

Key Tips for the Final Night:

Move Constantly: Avoid staying in one spot to manage the sanity meter.

Flashlight Usage: Do not keep the flashlight on. Use it sparingly, keeping it pointed at the floor, only to locate batteries or when an animatronic charges.

Battery Management: Spot and pick up batteries located around the map to keep your flashlight functioning.

Enemy Tactics: Burn enemies like Charlotte and the Puppet, and prioritize resetting the breakers.

Audio Clues: Utilize audio panning to determine the direction of charging enemies.

Phase 2: Prepare for a change in mechanics around 4:00 AM.

comments.text:
Cory, just for you to know if you play again: When the lullaby starts to play then the power goes out, it’s because Spring Freddy’s music box at night takes up too much power because it is the last of energy left in the building until the next day (you would know this stuff if you actually listened to the phone calls). But, there is a way to stop it. Once the music plays, you have a somewhat short amount of time to run back to your office and go to the back computer and click the Emergency Power Shutoff. This interrupts Spring Freddy’s song, and yes, you will be in the dark but it will take less time for you to cut the power back on. And I think the shutoff stops the animatronics while you reset it, but I don’t really remember from the last time I played? Anyway yeah, use this if you play again!

Cory, sorry for the late tips but heres what i can summarize,
Tip 1: There is an option to extend your fov and your brightness making it much eaiser to spot animatronics from long distances. (Im not sure how you can change settings but ive seen youtubers do so.
Tip 2: DONT USE YOUR SPRINT. Always try to preserve your sprint for emergencies and not for unwantedly walking around. 'the Thing' will always spawn near you after you shine him with your flashlight. 
Tip 3: When you see random white text on your screen, its something called sanity and it means you should move away from where your standing and keep walking. If you stand on the same spot for too long it will apear and kill you. So always keep moving.
Tip 4: you have to flip the breaker switch totally for about 6 times and make sure you dont flip it immediately but wait for your stamina to be full and then flip it.

Like so cory might see. Good luck on your playthroughs

comments.text:
8:25 
That's Spring Freddy's doing. He activates his showtime routine to drain your reserve power super duper fast.

 The way you get around that is by doing a manual power reset on the monitor before you hit 0 and the lights go out. It'll do a partial recharge, but you won't need to leave the office. Wait too long, and you'll have to initiate the reset on the monitor then flip the breaker, which is a lot more risky since you're basically running a lap around the entire building.

Freddy also doesn't return to his stage immediately when the power comes back on, sometimes he roams a little longer but he will eventually go back to stage.

As someone who beat night 5, here is a few tips, I know he already beat it but still gonna include this

basically there is a sanity meter that works like a time limit, you have to basically beat the night fast enough or you just die
Edit: when you were playing, you were kinda moving slow which is why you died that one time, you basically have to quickly and constantly run back n' fourth
